Rashi on Gittin 29a:10:1.english: If he said to him, "Deliver" - and he did not say to him, "You yourself deliver [it]":

Rashi on Gittin 29a:10:2.english: And if - [the Mishnah is in accordance with] Rabbi Shimon:

Rashi on Gittin 29a:10:3.hebrew: אפילו - לא אמר ליה "אתה הולך", כי חלה נמי לא:
Rashi on Gittin 29a:10:3.english: Even - [if] he did not say to him, "You, deliver," if he became sick, he also may not [appoint an agent].

Rashi on Gittin 29a:11:1.hebrew: ה"ז משלחו כו' - ולא מפליג בין חלה ללא חלה, ועושה שליח אחר, דהולך לא משמע אלא טרח שיבא גט זה לידה:
Rashi on Gittin 29a:11:1.english: This [agent] may send it, etc. - And [the baraita] does not distinguish between [a case where] he fell ill and [a case where] he did not fall ill, and he may appoint another agent, for "deliver" only implies, "take pains that this bill of divorce reaches her hand":

Rashi on Gittin 29a:12:1.hebrew: איבעית אימא - מתני' דאמר ליה "הולך", ואפ"ה בעינן חלה, דברייתא דקתני "ה"ז משלחו" — והוא דחלה:
Rashi on Gittin 29a:12:1.english: If you wish, say - [that] the Mishnah [is referring to a case] where he said to him, "Deliver," and even so we require [that he became] sick, for the baraita that teaches, "behold, this one may send it [with another]," [means] only when he became sick:

Rashi on Gittin 29a:12:2.hebrew: ואיבעית אימא - מתני' דאמר ליה "את הולך", וחלה שאני, ובריית' דקתני "לא ישלחנו" בדלא חלה; וכן נמי כי תוקמא כרבן שמעון, חלה שאני, ור"ש בשלא חלה:
Rashi on Gittin 29a:12:2.english: And if you wish, say - The Mishnah [refers to a case] where he said to him, "You deliver," [yet] one who became sick is different, and the baraita that teaches "he may not send it" [refers to a case] where he did not become sick; and similarly too, when you establish [the Mishnah] in accordance with Rabban Shimon [ben Gamliel], [a case where] he became sick is different, whereas Rabban Shimon [spoke] of [a case] where he did not become sick:

Rashi on Gittin 29a:13:1.hebrew: אמר לשנים תנו גט לאשתי - ולא נתן להם גט, עשאן עדים; ואע"פ שלא אמר להם "אתם עצמכם כתבוהו", הרי אלו יכתבו ויתנו, ולא יאמרו לסופר ויכתוב, כדמפרש לקמן:
Rashi on Gittin 29a:13:1.english: He said to two [people]: "Give a bill of divorce to my wife" - and he did not give them a bill of divorce: he has made them witnesses, and even though he did not say to them, "You yourselves write it," these [two] must write [it] and give [it], and they may not tell a scribe to write [it], as [the Gemara] explains later:

Rashi on Gittin 29a:13:2.hebrew: או לשלשה כתבו גט כו' יכתבו - הם עצמם, שהרי אמר להם "כתבו"; אבל אמר לשלשה "תנו גט לאשתי", יאמרו לאחרים ויכתבו ויתנו, מפני שעשאן ב"ד ורשאין לעשות שליח; אלמא, אין היחיד עושה שליח:
Rashi on Gittin 29a:13:2.english: Or [if he said] to three, "Write a bill of divorce," etc., [these] should write [it] - They themselves [must write it], for he said to them, "Write"; however, [if] he said to three, "Give a bill of divorce to my wife," they may tell others and they will write [it] and give [it], because he made them a court and they are permitted to appoint an agent; thus, an individual cannot appoint an agent.

Rashi on Gittin 29a:14:1.hebrew: בזיון דבעל - שעליו לכתוב את הגט, ואינו רוצה שידעו בו רבים שאינו יודע לכתבו:
Rashi on Gittin 29a:14:1.english: Degradation of the husband - because it is incumbent upon him to write the bill of divorce, and he does not want many [people] to know about him that he does not know [how] to write it:

Rashi on Gittin 29a:14:2.english: Here - regarding delivery [of the bill of divorce]:

Rashi on Gittin 29a:14:3.english: Is not particular - For what concern is there:

Rashi on Gittin 29a:15:1.hebrew: רבא אמר - התם היינו טעמא דלא משוו שליח, שלא מסר להם אלא דברים, ואין בדברים כח להיות חוזרים ונמסרים לאחר; אבל גט דאית ביה מששא, חוזר ונמסר:
Rashi on Gittin 29a:15:1.english: Rava said - There, this is the reason that they do not appoint an agent: because [the husband] handed over to them only words, and words do not have the power to be handed over again to another; whereas a get, which has [tangible] substance, can be handed over again:

Rashi on Gittin 29a:16:1.hebrew: שליח מתנה - שאמר בעל הבית לב' עדים: "כתבו שטר מתנה לפלוני"; אי טעמא דגט משום בזיון הוא, הכא ליכא למימר הכי, שהרי אין עליו לכותבו, דתנן (ב"ב דף קסז:): "והמקבל נותן את השכר", הלכך אם ירצו יאמרו לאחרים ויכתבו. ולמ"ד "מילי לא מימסרן", הני נמי לא מימסרן:
Rashi on Gittin 29a:16:1.english: An agent [for a] gift - [This refers to a case] where the owner [of the property] said to two witnesses: "Write a deed of gift for so-and-so." If the reason [for the restriction in the case] of a get is because of degradation [to the husband], here it is impossible to say so, since it is not [incumbent] upon him [the donor] to write it — as we learned in a Mishnah (Bava Batra 167b): "And the recipient pays the fee" — therefore, if they wish, they may tell others and they will write [it]. And according to the one who says [that] "words cannot be handed over [to another agent]," these [words] also cannot be handed over:

Rashi on Gittin 29a:17:1.english: Reish Lakish said: Here, Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi] taught - In this Mishnah, Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi] taught us:

Rashi on Gittin 29a:17:2.hebrew: אין השואל כו' - דהא דתנן "לא ישלחנו ביד אחר", לא משום בטולי שליחות דגיטא נקט לה — דאם שילח ביד אחר, הגט גט, דאע"ג דאין רצונו שיהא פקדונו ביד אחר, שליח לגרש מיהא שויה — אלא האי דתנן "לא ישלחנו", לאשמועינן דאין השואל רשאי להשאיל:
Rashi on Gittin 29a:17:2.english: A borrower is not [allowed], etc. - For that which we learned in the Mishnah, "he may not send it by the hand of another," was not stated because of nullification of the agency for the get — for if he did send [it] by the hand of another, the get is [still a valid] get, since even though [the husband] does not want his deposit to be in the hand of another, he nevertheless made him an agent to divorce — rather, this that we learned in the Mishnah, "he may not send it," [comes] to teach us that a borrower is not allowed to lend [the borrowed item to another]:

Rashi on Gittin 29a:18:1.hebrew: זו אפי' תינוקות יודעין אותה - דאם השאילה לו, לא לצורך אחרים השאילה לו, דאין השואל רשאי להשאיל, ונמצא זה עובר על דעתו ומקניטו:
Rashi on Gittin 29a:18:1.english: Even children know this - For if [the owner] lent it to him, he did not lend it to him for the use of others, since a borrower is not permitted to lend [it to another], and [thus] this [borrower] is found to be acting against his wishes and provoking him:

Rashi on Gittin 29a:18:2.hebrew: אלא - משום שליחות דגט גופיה תנא "לא ישלחנו", דאם שלחו ביד אחר, זימנין דגיטא נמי לא הוי גיטא; ולקמן מפרש מאי "זימנין":
Rashi on Gittin 29a:18:2.english: Rather - because of the agency of the bill of divorce itself, [the Tanna] taught "he may not send it," for if he sent it by the hand of another [person], sometimes it is not even a [valid] bill of divorce; and below [the Gemara] explains what "sometimes" [means]:

Rashi on Gittin 29a:18:3.hebrew: אל תגרשה אלא בימין וגרשה בשמאל - דלא שויה שליח להכי; האי נמי, פעמים ששליחות הגט תלוי בחפץ, ואיכא קפידא לבעל:
Rashi on Gittin 29a:18:3.english: Divorce her only with [your] right [hand], and he divorced her with [his] left [hand] - for he did not appoint him [as] an agent for this; [in] this [case] too, sometimes the agency of the get depends on an object, and the husband has a particular insistence [regarding it]:

Rashi on Gittin 29a:19:1.hebrew: דכולי עלמא כו' - דמדאמר ר' יוחנן "זימנין דגיטא נמי לא הוי", משמע דרוב פעמים הוי גיטא, ואפי' שלחו ביד אחר:
Rashi on Gittin 29a:19:1.english: Everyone [agrees], etc. - Since Rabbi Yochanan said, "sometimes it is not even a [valid] bill of divorce," this implies that most of the time it is a [valid] bill of divorce, even if he sent it through another [agent]:

Rashi on Gittin 29a:19:2.english: And she gave him an item - to that second agent:

Rashi on Gittin 29a:19:3.hebrew: דכ"ע לא פליגי דהוי גיטא - דאע"ג דאין רצונו שיהא פקדונו ביד אחר, שליחות דגיטא לא בטיל — ככל שלוחי גיטא שיכולין לעשות שליח — דאגט לא קפיד בעל לדבר זה, דגט אינו תלוי בחפץ, דאפשר שילך ויטול החפץ וישלח הגט ביד אחר; הלכך, אפי' שינה בחפץ, אין זה שינוי בגט, שהרי קיבל החפץ ואח"כ נתן:
Rashi on Gittin 29a:19:3.english: Everyone agrees that it is a [valid] bill of divorce - For even though he [the husband] does not want his deposit to be in the hand of another [person], the agency for the bill of divorce is not nullified — like all agents for a bill of divorce, who can appoint an agent — for regarding the bill of divorce, the husband is not particular about this matter, as the bill of divorce is not dependent on the item, since it is possible that he [the first agent] could go and take the item and send the bill of divorce via another [person]; therefore, even if he deviated regarding the item, this is not a deviation regarding the bill of divorce, since he received the item and afterward gave [the bill of divorce]:

Rashi on Gittin 29a:2:1.hebrew: תו לא חזו ליה זכותא - כלומר, לא שכיח, הלכך לא מספקינן בהכי:
Rashi on Gittin 29a:2:1.english: They no longer see a merit [for acquittal] for him - That is to say, it is not common; therefore, we are not in doubt regarding this:

Rashi on Gittin 29a:8:1.hebrew: המביא גט בא"י - שאין צריך לומר "בפני נכתב ונחתם":
Rashi on Gittin 29a:8:1.english: One who brings a get in Eretz Yisrael - [in a case] where he does not need to say, "In my presence it was written and in my presence it was signed":

Rashi on Gittin 29a:8:2.hebrew: משלחו ביד אחר - ועושה שליח מאליו ושלא בב"ד:
Rashi on Gittin 29a:8:2.english: He sends it in the possession of another - and he appoints an agent on his own, without [appearing before] a court:

Rashi on Gittin 29a:8:3.english: And if he said to him - [the] husband [said] to the agent:

Rashi on Gittin 29a:8:4.hebrew: טול לי הימנה חפץ פלוני - כשתתן לה את הגט, לא ישלחנו ביד אחר:
Rashi on Gittin 29a:8:4.english: Take for me such-and-such an item from her - [meaning,] when you give her the bill of divorce, he may not send it in the possession of another [agent]:

Rashi on Gittin 29a:9:1.hebrew: חלה תנן - דאניס, וה"ה לכל אונסין; אבל אי לא אניס, לא ישלחנו ביד אחר:
Rashi on Gittin 29a:9:1.english: We learned, "He became sick" - [meaning] that he was prevented [by unavoidable circumstances], and the same applies to all unavoidable circumstances; however, if he was not prevented, he may not send it via another [agent].

Tosafot on Gittin 29a:14:1.hebrew: רשב"ג אומר בין כך ובין כך לא ישלחנו ביד אחר - והא דדרשינן (קדושין דף מא.) "ושלח ושלחה", מלמד שהשליח עושה שליח — היינו היכא דאין הבעל מקפיד:
Tosafot on Gittin 29a:14:1.english: Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel says: Either way, he may not send it via another - And that which we expound (Kiddushin 41a), "and he sends," "and he sends her," [which] teaches that an agent may appoint an agent — that is [only] where the husband is not particular:

Tosafot on Gittin 29a:14:2.hebrew: משום בזיון דבעל - פירש בקונטרס שעליו לכתוב את הגט, ואינו רוצה שידעו רבים שאינו יודע לכותבו. והא דקאמר "יכתבו ויתנו", אגב "יכתבו" נקט "יתנו"; אי נמי, על ידי שיאמרו לאחר שיתן, ירגיש בדבר שהבעל לא כתבו, ומקפיד גם על הנתינה. וא"ת: מאי בזיון איכא? והא תנן (לעיל גיטין דף כב:): "האשה כותבת את גיטה", אלמא אין על הבעל לכתוב! וי"ל דלעולם על הבעל לכתוב, אלא הא קא משמע לן דאפילו אשה כותבת כשר, דידעת לאקנויי:
Tosafot on Gittin 29a:14:2.english: Due to degradation of the husband - Rashi explained that it is incumbent upon him to write the bill of divorce, and he does not want many people to know that he does not know how to write it. And as for what [the Mishnah] says, "they shall write and give" — it mentioned "give" incidentally alongside "they shall write"; alternatively, by telling another person to give [it], [that person] will realize that the husband did not write it, and [therefore] he is also particular about the giving. And if you ask: What degradation is there? Behold, we learned in a Mishnah (above, Gittin 22b): "A woman may write her own bill of divorce," thus [we see] it is not incumbent upon the husband to write [it]! And one can answer that in truth it is incumbent upon the husband to write [it]; rather, this is what [that Mishnah] teaches us: that even if a woman writes [it], it is valid, because she knows how to transfer ownership [of it to the husband]:

Tosafot on Gittin 29a:15:1.hebrew: ומילי לא מימסרן לשליח - ר"מ ור' יוסי פליגי לקמן בפ' התקבל (גיטין דף סו:) באומר לשלשה "תנו", דקסבר ר"מ דעשאן ב"ד, ור' יוסי פליג, דאפי' אמר לב"ד הגדול שבירושלים, ילמדו ויכתבו ויתנו לה. אבל באומר לשנים "תנו", או לשלשה "כתבו ותנו", אפילו ר"מ מודה דיכתבו ויתנו, ולא מימסרי לשליח, כדמוכח מתניתין דהתם. והא דקאמר בגמ': שלחו ליה מבי רב לשמואל, אמר לשנים "כתבו ותנו גט לאשתי", ואמרו לסופר וכתב וחתמו הן, מהו? שלח להו: תצא, והדבר צריך תלמוד; ופריך מהא דאמר שמואל: הלכה כרבי יוסי דאמר מילי לא מימסרן לשליח — הוה מצי למיפרך דבשנים אפילו ר"מ מודה דלא מימסרן, אלא ניחא ליה לאקשויי שמואל אדשמואל. ועוד, דהוה מצי למימר דטעמיה דר"מ משום בזיון דבעל, וקסבר שמואל דבכתיבה ליכא בזיון, אבל בחתימה כשיחתמו אחרים הוא דאיכא בזיון, דמיפרסמא מילתא בחתימה טפי; ומיהו הוה מצי למיפרך מדשמואל דהכא, דקסבר טעמא משום מילי, דאמר "מתנה הרי היא כגט", אלא כיון שהיה צריך להביא משמואל דהכא, ה"נ פריך מאידך דשמואל דהתם:
Tosafot on Gittin 29a:15:1.english: And words cannot be transferred to an agent - Rabbi Meir and Rabbi Yosei disagree later in the chapter [entitled] Hamekabel (Gittin 66b) regarding one who says to three [people], "Give [a bill of divorce to my wife]," as Rabbi Meir holds that he made them a court, whereas Rabbi Yosei disagrees, [holding] that even if he said [it] to the Great Court in Jerusalem, they must learn [how to write it], write [it], and give [it] to her [themselves]. However, regarding one who says to two [people], "Give," or to three [people], "Write and give," even Rabbi Meir agrees that they [themselves] must write and give [it], and [the instructions] cannot be transferred to an agent, as is proven from the Mishnah there. And [as for] that which [the Gemara] says: They sent [an inquiry] from the academy of Rav to Shmuel: "[If a husband] said to two [people], 'Write and give a bill of divorce to my wife,' and they told a scribe and he wrote [it], and they [themselves] signed [it], what is [the law]?" He sent [back] to them: "She must leave [her second husband], and the matter requires [further] study"; and [the Gemara] challenges [this] from that which Shmuel said: "The halakha is in accordance with Rabbi Yosei, who said that words cannot be transferred to an agent" — [the Gemara] could have challenged [him by noting] that with two [people], even Rabbi Meir agrees that [words] cannot be transferred; rather, it preferred to raise a contradiction between Shmuel and Shmuel [himself]. And furthermore, [Shmuel] could have answered that Rabbi Meir's reason is because of the husband's embarrassment, and Shmuel holds that in writing [alone] there is no embarrassment, whereas in signing — when others sign — there is embarrassment, because the matter becomes more publicized through signing; however, [the Gemara] could have challenged [that] from Shmuel here, who holds that the reason is because of "words," as he said [above], "A gift is like a bill of divorce" — rather, since it would have had to bring [a proof] from Shmuel here, it likewise challenged [him] from the other [statement] of Shmuel there:

Tosafot on Gittin 29a:17:1.hebrew: כאן שנה רבי אין השואל רשאי להשאיל - אפילו למאן דאמר בהמפקיד (ב"מ דף לו.) שומר שמסר לשומר פטור, שהרי מסרו לבן דעת, דאין יכול לומר לו "אין רצוני שיהא פקדוני ביד אחר" — נהי דלא מיחייב, מ"מ לכתחלה אין לו לעשות:
Tosafot on Gittin 29a:17:1.english: Here Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi] taught: A borrower is not allowed to lend - Even according to the one who says in [the chapter] HaMafkid (Bava Metzia 36a) [that] a bailee who entrusted [a deposit] to [another] bailee is exempt, because he entrusted it to a mentally competent person, so that [the owner] cannot say to him, "It is not my wish that my deposit be in the possession of another" — although he is not liable, nevertheless, initially he should not do [so]:

Tosafot on Gittin 29a:19:1.hebrew: היכא דנפקה לאפיה - נקט הכי משום דמתניתין איירי בחלה השליח הראשון, ולא הגיע לעיר שהאשה שם:
Tosafot on Gittin 29a:19:1.english: When she went out to greet him - [The Gemara] phrased it this way because the Mishnah deals with [a case where] the first agent fell ill and did not reach the city where the woman is:

Tosafot on Gittin 29a:1:1.hebrew: אבל בב"ד של ישראל כיון דגמר דיניה לקטלא מיקטל קטלי ליה - אע"ג דאמר בסנהדרין (דף מב:) שהיה אחד רוכב על סוס וסודרין בידו, מצאו לו זכות, היה הלה מניף בסודרין — מכל מקום לא שכיח:
Tosafot on Gittin 29a:1:1.english: But in a Jewish court, once his verdict to be executed has been finalized, they execute him - Even though [the Gemara] states in Sanhedrin (42b) that one [person] would ride on a horse with kerchiefs in his hand, [and if] they found a point in his favor, that one would wave the kerchiefs [to halt the execution] — nevertheless, [such a reversal] is not common:
